title: approved-slice-plan-export-v0 bundle.json
$comment: BEI-134. Supported keyword subset (see scripts/schema_check.py): type, required, properties, enum, items, minimum, pattern only - no oneOf/anyOf/additionalProperties/minItems/minLength. This schema declares SHAPE for scripts/validate_export.py; it never rejects extra keys and stays silent on a field's inner shape when the validator itself never inspected that inner shape (declared here as `{}` for doc/schema field-list parity only). The following stay in scripts/validate_export.py as code because the subset above cannot express them: (1) `supersedes` presence + null-vs-64-char-lowercase-sha256 + version-pairing (version 1 requires supersedes null, version >= 2 requires a hash) - a cross-field conditional; (2) `children` must be a non-empty list, and duplicate slice ids across children - minItems and cross-item uniqueness aren't in the subset; (3) `dependency_graph` edges reference known slice ids, cycle detection, and `slice_plan.parallel_groups` transitive-dependency exclusion - graph semantics, not shape; (4) that every child id has a matching `slices/<id>.json` + `slices/<id>.md` file, and no orphan slice manifests - requires reading the filesystem alongside the JSON. RON-146 (resolved): the executable exit-code command-proof contract lives under the distinct per-slice `command_proofs` field (see execution-envelope-v0.schema.json), NOT under `proof_requirements` - `proof_requirements` here stays the untouched proof-requirement-v1 attestation shape (see docs/configuration.md 'Proof Requirement v1'); its inner shape remains unenforced at bundle level, as before BEI-134.

status.$comment: Export validation is fail-closed: only approved bundles pass this gate. draft/paused/completed/superseded are valid pre-export execution-envelope-v0 states per docs/configuration.md ('Execution Envelope v0'), but bundle.json itself never carries them past validate_export.py.

generated_from.$comment: Required as a key (see top-level `required`); its content has never been type-checked by the validator, so no constraint is declared here.

source_work_contract.$comment: Required as a key; observed as both a string and an object across committed bundles/fixtures, and the validator never inspects its shape.

slice_plan.$comment: Required as a key. May carry `parallel_groups` (validated in code against dependency_graph and children); the validator does not require slice_plan itself to be an object (a non-object slice_plan silently skips parallel_groups validation rather than failing).

proof_requirements.$comment: proof-requirement-v1 items per docs/configuration.md 'Proof Requirement v1'; shape not enforced here (validator never inspected this array's shape at bundle level). RON-146's executable command-proof shape is a distinct field, `command_proofs`, declared per-slice in execution-envelope-v0.schema.json - it does not live here.

guides_and_gates.$comment: Required as a key; content never type-checked by the validator.

runner_extensions.$comment: Required as a key at bundle level; the validator only ever inspects runner_extensions.model_routing on a per-SLICE manifest (see schemas/execution-envelope-v0.schema.json), never on the bundle itself.

rubric_version.$comment: Known rubric versions (KNOWN_RUBRIC_VERSIONS in scripts/validate_export.py); the validator rejects any rubric_version it does not know.

ownership.$comment: Required as a key; content never type-checked by the validator.

supersedes.$comment: Not in `required` above (matching REQUIRED_BUNDLE_FIELDS, which excludes it) but effectively mandatory: scripts/validate_export.py separately requires the key to be present and, when non-null, a 64-char lowercase sha256 hex digest, with version 1 requiring null and version >= 2 requiring a hash. That cross-field conditional is outside this schema's supported subset and stays in code.
